title: Early trumpet players he admired
summary: King Oliver, Manuel Perez, Freddie Keppard and Emil Christian were the trumpet players he heard coming up.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: I was going to ask one more question before we quit, if, unless there's something else particularly you wanted to add. I was going to ask if there are any early trumpet players when you first started out that you admired and copied more than any of you? That is not necessarily copied, but I mean, as you heard when you were a boy that you, what was the greatest when you were a kid?
Well, King Oliver was one. Manuel Perez was one.
Yeah. Another one? You remember, you heard all those fellows.
Oh, yeah. Uh, of course, Louie, I heard afterwards.
Yeah, he was a young kid. Yeah. Younger than you are. He's only 58 now.

Yeah. Well, Louie came up after Joe went to Chicago, see. And, uh, when Manuel Perez played a sweet trumpet, nice, beautiful trumpet. But Joe could blast as high as the sky, see. Yeah. And Freddie Keppard could do the same. And the white boys, a kid by the name of Emil Christian. Oh, yeah.
He's still there. He's working there. He plays bass, though. He plays bass, yeah. And still plays good trombone, though.
Oh, but he was a high trumpet player.
